comparison_to_previous_adapter.limits: Different training representations, per-mode exposures and supervised token volume. This is not an isolated causal ablation or final multi-seed method result.

interpretation: Both fact modes move from base 0/84 to learned outputs; this is genuine observed learning in the diagnostic, not a claim of full acceptance.
Mixed-mode training improves thinking fact output descriptively relative to the prior adapter, while one declared fact-mode gate set still fails.

Failures concentrate in year and reverse-lookup questions; traces include invented prize-to-prize relations, wrong years, wrong authors, one wrong answer type and one completed correct-year-with-extra-text output.
Low response CE does not prove correct held-out-wording generation or independent composition.
Arithmetic remains 10/10 on these repeatedly used development probes; this is not a general utility benchmark.
No threshold changes, selective record exclusions, additional updates or unlearning were performed in this review.
next_step: Before another SFT change, compare generation on the original training wording versus held-out development wording using this saved adapter under prespecified modes/seeds. This can distinguish training-prompt recall from wording/mode generalization issues; it is proposed, not implemented/run. Consider multi-seed stability before broad claims.
